questions.q: How does Mia feel when she finds new words?
questions.explanation: Mia finds unfamiliar words and feels worried at the beginning.

questions.q: Why does Leo show Mia the picture?
choices: To help her understand a word
To tell her the end of the story
To show her his new book
To help her count the pages
questions.explanation: Mia understands a new word when she looks at the picture.

questions.q: Who helps with the word Mia does not understand from the picture?
questions.explanation: The teacher helps Mia understand the other word.

questions.q: Why does Mia put a question mark near the train sentence?
choices: She wants to remember the train
She does not understand it yet
She wants to finish reading early
She wants Leo to write for her
questions.explanation: The question mark shows the place where Mia needs help.

questions.q: Why does Mia write new words in her notebook?
choices: To give the notebook to Leo
To make her book look nice
To count how many pages she reads
questions.explanation: Mia keeps two words in her notebook as part of learning.

questions.q: Why does Mia smile on Friday?
choices: Her teacher gives her a gift
The story has no new words
Her friend reads the story for her
questions.explanation: Mia understands more of the new story and feels happy.

questions.q: Your friend cannot read a new word. What can you suggest?
choices: Look at a picture and try again
questions.explanation: Leo uses the picture to help Mia understand a word.

questions.q: Why does Mia want to read again tomorrow?
choices: She can see that practice helps
Leo must give her all the answers
Every story is now very easy
questions.explanation: Mia understands more and wants to keep practising.

questions.q: Where could you keep words that are new to you?
questions.explanation: Mia writes two unfamiliar words in her notebook.

questions.q: What is the best message from Mia's story?
choices: Stop when a word is new
questions.explanation: Mia learns through a second reading and asking for help.
